title: John Song and Jean Stack Join Evercore as Senior Managing Directors to Expand the Aerospace & Defense Investment Banking Team
summary: Evercore announced today that John Song and Jean Stack have joined the firm as senior managing directors in the industrials investment banking group, focused on aerospace & defense. Both will be based in the Washington, D.C. area, expanding Evercore’s presence in the region.
